scope: Time Patrol Support Pack Power Pole Combo canonical identity reconciliation
purpose: Establish the exact canonical identity and acquisition/mechanics evidence for Power Pole Combo without aliasing it to Power Pole or Power Pole Pro.

identity_evidence.finding: Dedicated Xenoverse 2 page identifies Power Pole Combo as a Strike Super used by Goku (GT), with 100 Ki, seven-hit behavior, tracking, and Power Pole Moves categorization.
Dragon Ball Wiki separately identifies Power Pole Combo from Power Pole and Power Pole Pro and states that in Xenoverse 2 it is obtainable from the Skill Shop.

separation_rules: Power Pole Combo is not an alias of Power Pole.
Power Pole Combo is not an alias of Power Pole Pro.
The Support Pack is provenance/early-access evidence, not exclusive ownership, because the official storefront states some content can be obtained through the in-game shop or conditions.
next_action: Continue the five remaining unmatched Support Pack costume identities, using individually source-backed evidence and preserving the existing equipment architecture.
